title: Sable and the Weather
author: Paloma Nystrom
blurb: Rosalind Okafor, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
